algorithm_contract.engine: WarpLDA through text2vec for the registered screening implementation
algorithm_contract.warning: The defaults document the pinned upstream implementation, not an activated benchmark recipe. The topic grid, selection rule, seed roster, filtering, and head remain blocked until a separate TaskSpec freezes them without held-donor access.

embedding_contract.warning: No predict method or inductive held-cell transform was found in the pinned R implementation. Appending held cells and refitting LDA would fit on the evaluation rows and is prohibited.

implementation.upstream_replacement_notice: The repository directs new users to pycisTopic; that distinct implementation is not substituted into this registry entry.

input_contract.peak_policy: Define and order the consensus region universe using outer-training donors only. Project held observed-ATAC rows to that frozen universe only for methods with a valid inductive transform; cisTopic 0.3.0 itself has none.
input_contract.warning: A region absent because an assay, reference crosswalk, or permission is unavailable is missing evidence, not a measured zero. GSE244832 RNA and ATAC nuclei are not cell-paired.

leakage_contract.inference_consequence: Because the registered implementation has no inductive transform, it cannot produce a score for a genuinely held cell. It may be used only for training-partition diagnostics or a prospectively defined transductive development analysis that makes no external or champion claim.

runtime_contract.required_record: Freeze the exact R package closure, R sessionInfo(), seeds, sparse-matrix implementation, CPU/BLAS details, and project artifact hashes before any run.

safe_loading_contract.restore_policy: Restore only project-generated objects. Validate expected class and slots, region and cell identifiers, topic dimensions, finite values, nonnegativity, and probability normalization before use.
safe_loading_contract.warning: Do not accept an external RDS/RData object or execute code embedded in an untrusted serialized workspace.

source_evidence: The exact cisTopic commit, its DESCRIPTION and model source, the upstream deprecation notice, and the 2019 primary article were checked on 2026-08-22. No package was installed and no model was trained or loaded.

source_records.identity: cisTopic DESCRIPTION at the pinned revision
cisTopic model-fitting source at the pinned revision

task_fit.development_only_candidate: Training-partition ATAC topic diagnostics after a separate nonpromotable ATAC-representation TaskSpec; it is not a held-cell benchmark until an independently audited inductive implementation is registered.
task_fit.rna_conditioned_atac: ineligible because the model consumes observed target-cell ATAC and does not predict an ATAC profile from RNA/context
task_fit.sealed_cell_state_mapping: ineligible because GSE289173 exposes RNA-only nuclei and cisTopic lacks an RNA input
task_fit.variant_to_regulation: ineligible because there is no nucleotide-sequence or allele-effect mechanism
